# B2B Terms

Revision 7 / English legal presentation

## English

### 1. Administrator and service provider

SeedTrade.eu platform administrator: MB "Gate-V", company registration number 306795035.

Service provider: MB "Gate-V", a Lithuanian small partnership registered in the Lithuanian Register of Legal Entities on 2024-05-22. Registered address: Varnėnų g. 52, LT-37171 Panevėžys, Lithuania. VAT ID LT100017200917. Service, privacy and reporting contact: info@seedtrade.eu, in Lithuanian or English. Effective 2026-11-13.

### 2. Professional use, fees and agreement

B2B V1 is free and for business entities and authorized representatives acting professionally; consumer personal purchasing is excluded. Representatives must be authorized to register and accept these Terms for the business, provide accurate details and report when authority ends.

The platform agreement begins when a pending account and acceptance of the exact Terms/declaration versions are saved. This does not approve the company. Verification-mail failure does not undo a saved account; do not register repeatedly when delivery is uncertain. Providing privacy information is not blanket data-processing consent or marketing permission.

### 3. Approval and security

Trading requires verified email and separate independent company review. Self-approval is forbidden. Relevant profile changes return the company to review and published offers to draft. Email verification proves mailbox control; company approval does not guarantee solvency, goods, certification or legality. Protect credentials and report suspected unauthorized access to info@seedtrade.eu.

### 4. Offers and business transactions

Approved companies can prepare and publish supported seed offers, enquire about another company's offer, reply and close offers or exchanges. Other approved companies see exposed company-name/offer fields; participants and administrators performing necessary authorized functions can access their shared thread. Submission does not automatically publish complete profiles or messages. Public website listings and account-based offers are separate flows.

Businesses agree their own goods, price, contract, payment and delivery and meet applicable seed/product obligations. The platform has no payment collection, escrow, delivery or automatic sale-contract execution. Account use does not itself make the administrator a party to a sale. Market indicators are not individual quotations or transaction guarantees. Seller declarations and company approval are not product certification.

### 5. Content and permitted use

Submit lawful, accurate content you are authorized to disclose. Do not impersonate, bypass security, spam, offer unlawful goods or infringe rights. Avoid unnecessary sensitive or third-party data. Responsibility for submitted content does not remove the administrator's legal duties.

Users retain content rights and grant only non-exclusive permission to store, process and display content to intended lawful recipients as necessary for the service, security and lawful moderation. This grants no unrelated marketing, resale or model-training permission. Platform/source material retains its applicable rights and licences.

### 6. Service messages

Service mail covers verification, requested verification resends and implemented enquiry/seller-reply notices. These do not subscribe anyone to newsletters. Registration does not enable optional marketing or non-essential analytics. The separate Privacy Notice describes processing and rights.

### 7. Reports, decisions and review

Report potentially illegal content to info@seedtrade.eu or follow /legal/report/ instructions; no account is needed. Identify the exact location/record, reasons, good-faith accuracy statement and contact where lawfully required, subject to applicable statutory identity exceptions. Do not transmit unnecessary unlawful material.

An authorized human assesses the notice, evidence and urgency; records grounds, action, scope, duration and time; and provides applicable reasons, notifications and remedies. Automated illegality decisions are not used. Reconsideration is available through the same inbox, with another human where practicable. Seven working days is an ordinary internal response target; urgent action and mandatory deadlines take priority. Where DSA Article 20 applies, complaints remain possible for at least six months from notification, with applicable out-of-court and judicial remedies preserved.

### 8. Restrictions and closure

Proportionate restrictions may address credible security threats, suspected unlawful use, lost authority or binding lawful orders. Reasons are provided promptly except where lawfully restricted. Ordinarily allow seven calendar days to remedy a non-urgent remediable breach before termination. Company restriction is not described as removing only one item.

Authorized representatives can request closure at info@seedtrade.eu at any time without a V1 closure fee. Authority is checked, open exchanges addressed and a reasonable secure route provided to lawfully available records. Closure does not indiscriminately erase counterparties' records or justified evidence. Ordinary operator discontinuance or material Terms changes receive 30 calendar days' notice, subject to lawful urgent exceptions and mandatory rules. Renewed affirmative acceptance is obtained where required.

### 9. Rights, liability and versions

Applicable statutory liability, governing-law and jurisdiction rules apply. These Terms impose no additional monetary liability cap or exclusive chosen court. Contacting info@seedtrade.eu does not restrict legal remedies. Immutable accepted document versions remain available and historical acceptance is not rewritten. These Terms take effect on 2026-11-13.
